extension.description: Browse Apple's top podcasts and genre charts, search, subscribe and play episodes. My Latest Episodes picks up where you left off and lists new episodes from the podcasts you follow. Optional gPodder sync (oPodSync, gpodder.net or Nextcloud gPodder Sync) keeps subscriptions and play positions the same across your Kodi devices.
extension.disclaimer: Podcast listings come from Apple; episodes play straight from each podcast's own feed.
extension.news: v1.0.4 - My Unplayed Podcasts lists podcasts with episodes waiting (and how many); My Latest Episodes shows each podcast's oldest unplayed episode, filling gaps, or episode 1 of one you haven't started. v1.0.3 - New My Unplayed Podcasts (subscriptions you haven't started); My Latest Episodes shows the next episode by release date after the last one you played, not the newest. v1.0.2 - Home-screen widgets made from My Podcasts or My Latest Episodes refresh after you play, mark, subscribe or sync (re-add existing widgets once). v1.0.1 - Played episodes are dimmed and marked Played (Kodi shows no watched tick for audio); Go to podcast now works from home-screen widgets. v1.0.0 - First release: My Podcasts, My Latest Episodes, Trending (Apple genre charts), Top Podcasts, Search, resume, and gPodder sync.
